title: The Art of Hierarchical Competing Patterns: Gaussian Process Optimization of Hyphenation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyphenation patterns remain a compact and widely deployed solution for word breaking in typesetting systems, text processors, and web rendering engines, but their generation still depends on manually tuned patgen program parameter profiles. We formulate patgen profile selection as a black-box hyperparameter optimization problem and evaluate Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization for this task. The search objective combines a precision-oriented F_{1/7}-score with an explicit trie size-accuracy trade-off using a normalized trie-size penalty.   We evaluate the method on 17 hyphenated word-list datasets covering 14 languages and multiple scripts. Against two strong hand-tuned profiles regenerated from the same 8/10 training split and evaluated on the same 1/10 held-out test split, the GP-optimized profiles improve F_{1/7} on 16 of 17 datasets and reduce trie size on all 17. The median optimized/baseline trie ratio is 0.407. A dataset-level

translated_title: 层次竞争模式的艺术：连字符断词的高斯过程优化
translated_abstract: 连字模式（断词模式）仍然是排版系统、文本处理器和网页渲染引擎中单词断行的一种紧凑且广泛部署的解决方案，但其生成仍然依赖于手动调整的 patgen 程序参数配置。我们将 patgen 配置的选择形式化为一个黑盒超参数优化问题，并评估了高斯过程贝叶斯优化在该任务上的效果。搜索目标将面向精确率的 F_{1/7} 分数与通过归一化字典树（trie）大小惩罚实现的显式字典树大小-精度权衡相结合。我们在涵盖 14 种语言和多种文字系统的 17 个带连字符划分的词表数据集上评估了该方法。与基于相同 8/10 训练集划分重新生成、并在相同 1/10 留出测试集划分上评估的两个强人工调优配置相比，高斯过程优化的配置在 17 个数据集中的 16 个上提升了 F_{1/7} 分数，并在全部 17 个数据集上减小了字典树大小。优化后配置与基线的字典树大小比值中位数为 0.407。一个数据集层面的……
tldr: 该论文将连字模式生成中 patgen 参数配置的选择形式化为黑盒超参数优化问题，通过高斯过程贝叶斯优化，在涵盖 14 种语言的 17 个数据集上几乎全面提升了断词 F_{1/7} 分数，同时将字典树体积中位数缩减至基线的 0.407。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates patgen profile selection for hyphenation pattern generation as a black-box hyperparameter optimization problem, showing that Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization improves the F_{1/7} score on 16 of 17 datasets across 14 languages while reducing trie size on all datasets, with a median trie-size ratio of 0.407 versus hand-tuned baselines.
